raw_output:
Giver: Hi, can you hear me?
Follower: Yeah, I can. What's the map?
Giver: Just a simple one. Can you see it?
Follower: Yep. Where do I start?
Giver: Okay, find the START point on your map. It's a cross near the bottom.
Follower: Found it. Looks like it's a bit lower left than mine? No, wait.
Giver: Don't worry about the position, just find it. Now, look at the stony desert. Where is it relative to your start?
Follower: Oh, it's right next to it. Actually, on my map, the stony desert is way up near the top right.
Giver: Whoops, okay. Let's restart. Find the stony desert. Is it on the right side of your map?
Follower: Yeah, it's on the right.
Giver: Good. From your START, face the stony desert. Draw a line towards it, but stop short. Then turn left and draw a line going down.
Follower: Okay, facing the desert... drawn a bit towards it... turned left... going down.
Giver: Keep going down until you hit the collapsed shelter. Is that on your map?
Follower: Yes, I see the collapsed shelter. It's down there.
Giver: Great. From the shelter, turn right and head towards the savannah. Draw a line to it.
Follower: Okay, turned right... heading for the savannah. Wait, is the savannah on the right side of the shelter?
Giver: Yes, the savannah is on the right. Keep going until you reach it.
Follower: Okay, reaching the savannah. Now turn left and go towards the waterhole. Is there a waterhole on your map?
Giver: No, we don't go to the waterhole. Go left from the savannah until you see the slate mountain.
Follower: Ah, I see the slate mountain. It's on the left. Drawing towards it.
Giver: Good. Once you're next to the slate mountain, turn right and head towards the hot springs.
Follower: Hot springs? I see hot springs on my map. Drawing towards it.
Giver: Okay, once you're close to the hot springs, turn left and head towards the white mountain.
Follower: White mountain... it's up there. Drawing towards it. Wait, is it on the right or left?
Giver: It's on the right of your path. Go towards it.
Follower: Okay, heading for the white mountain. Wait, I don't see it on my map. Is it missing?
Giver: Oh, you don't have the white mountain? That's fine. Just keep going straight until you see the lake.
Follower: Lake! There it is. Drawing towards the lake.
Giver: Good. Once you're next to the lake, turn left and head towards the roman baths.
Follower: Roman baths? I see it. Drawing towards it.
Giver: Perfect. Once you're next to the roman baths, turn right and head towards the antelope.
Follower: Antelope... there it is. Drawing towards it.
Giver: Great. Once you're next to the antelope, keep going straight towards the FINISH. Draw a line to it.
Follower: Wait, I don't see a FINISH on my map. Is it missing?
Giver: Oh, you don't have the finish? That's okay. Just keep going straight past the antelope. Where does it end?
Follower: I'm drawing a line... it seems to go right next to the site of the plane crash. Is that where the finish is?
Giver: No, the finish is further down. Go past the plane crash site, turn left, and keep going until you reach the stony desert again.
Follower: Wait, I thought I started near the stony desert?
Giver: No, start at the bottom, go up, then follow the path I gave you. Just keep going until you hit the stony desert again. That's the finish.
Follower: Okay, going up... past the plane crash... left... hitting the stony desert. Is this the finish?
Giver: Yes, that's it. You've reached the finish.
Follower: Great! Done.
Giver: Perfect. Bye.
Follower: Bye.
